Provident Real Estate Broker LLC – Business Bay proudly presents this elegant 2-bedroom apartment in District One Residences 13 in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (District One), offering a modern lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront communities.

This beautifully designed residence features 2 spacious bedrooms, 3 contemporary bathrooms, and a bright, well-planned layout complemented by premium finishes throughout. Ideal for residents seeking comfort, convenience, and a high-quality living experience in the heart of Dubai.

Residents enjoy access to exceptional amenities, including swimming pools, a fully equipped fitness center, landscaped outdoor spaces, and the iconic Crystal Lagoon. The community also offers seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and major road networks.

Rental Price: AED 160,000 per year

Property Features:
• 2 Bedrooms

• 1 Covered Parking Space
• Spacious Living & Dining Area
• Modern Kitchen with Premium Finishes
• Built-in Wardrobes

Experience refined waterfront living in a vibrant community just minutes from Dubai’s most prominent destinations. Contact Provident Real Estate Broker LLC – Business Bay today to arrange a viewing.
